## Shared scenes

> [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) arrange a bed in the garret for Mary, who is anxious about her head's cleanliness and her sleeping arrangements. Later, [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) hears Mary crying in the garret and goes to comfort her. After discussing Mary's fear of going back to Mrs. [Wiley](../character/wiley.md) and a brief argument over [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md), the two girls reconcile and fall asleep together.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P93](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0093), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P96](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0096), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P106](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0106), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P127](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0127)_

> [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) and [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) debate religious matters and the household before Mary warns [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) that their father might marry again, leaving [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) terrified of getting a stepmother. Meanwhile, [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) stays up all night reading about St. Augustine, briefly reflecting on his late wife Cecelia and his children before going to bed.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P80](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0080), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P85](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0085), [v5 CHAPTER IX. > [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) becomes deeply absorbed in studying [German](../codex/factions.md#german) theology, resulting in complete distraction from his pastoral and domestic duties. Mrs. [Alec Davis](../character/alec-davis.md) arrives at the manse and abruptly demands to adopt [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), which Mr. Meredith firmly refuses. Outraged, Mrs. [Davis](../character/davis.md) berates him for neglecting his children, leaving him shaken and reflecting on how to properly care for his family.
>

> After [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md) insults [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md) confronts him and agrees to a fight the next evening. Despite his dread, Walter wins the battle after school, defending [Faith](../character/faith.md) and his mother. On his way home through [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), he meets Mr. Meredith, who approves of his fighting for a good cause, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later comforts him after hearing what happened.
>

> In [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), [Faith](../character/faith.md) meets [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), who warmly comforts her about the death of her pet rooster, [Adam](../character/adam.md), and promises to give her a canary. [Faith](../character/faith.md) returns home feeling comforted and enthusiastically praises Miss West to her family during supper.
>

> The [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) decides to fast for a day as self-punishment, but the lack of food causes [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) to faint during the church service. Doctor [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) revives her and prescribes a solid meal, leaving [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) guilt-ridden about neglecting his motherless children.
>

> [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) tells [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) gossip about why [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) rejected their father and accuses [Carl](../character/carl.md) of putting an eel in Mrs. Carr's buggy. After learning about Carl's prank, [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) decides to whip him, but breaks down and refuses to go through with the punishment when he looks into Carl's eyes.
>

> [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) visits [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) to ask her to marry her father, [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), willing to risk having a stepmother for her father's happiness. [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) reassures [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) that she will be a friend rather than a cruel stepmother and gives her a note for her father, which restores John Meredith's spirits upon receiving it.
